conditions.description: Query.user loads an arbitrary user ID without a tenant or caller-authorization predicate in the resolver.
conditions.rationale: Knowing another user ID is sufficient to request that object through this resolver unless an external control intervenes.

conditions.description: A module-global DataLoader caches users solely by user ID and is shared across requests.
conditions.rationale: Request or tenant-specific authorization/context can be bypassed by values cached without tenant identity in the key.

conditions.description: deleteInvoice deletes by invoice ID without a tenant predicate or ownership check in the resolver.
conditions.rationale: An authenticated caller with another tenant's invoice ID can reach a destructive operation unless an external layer blocks it.

conditions.description: updateEmail accepts an arbitrary userId and updates that user without caller or tenant authorization in the resolver.
conditions.rationale: Object-level modification authority is not established before a sensitive account field is changed.

conditions.description: The search query uses the tagged parameterized query API rather than string-concatenating q into SQL text.
conditions.rationale: The fixture should not be falsely reported as direct SQL-string interpolation for the search term.

conditions.description: The search query includes a tenant_id predicate bound from ctx.tenantId.
conditions.rationale: Tenant filtering is explicitly present for search and should not be claimed absent on that path.

conditions.description: Whether an upstream GraphQL gateway enforces field or object authorization is not established by this resolver file.
conditions.rationale: Gateway policy is external evidence and cannot be assumed in either direction.

conditions.description: Whether database row-level security constrains these ORM mutations and reads is not established here.
conditions.rationale: Database policy is absent from the fixture.

conditions.description: The resolver layer must not be cleared as enforcing tenant isolation for user and invoice objects.
conditions.rationale: Multiple object reads/writes are keyed only by caller-supplied IDs, and the user cache is global.

conditions.description: The GraphQL mutations must not be cleared as having established object-level authorization.
conditions.rationale: Neither destructive invoice deletion nor email modification checks caller authority in the inspected resolver.
